propositions: Duplicate policy frozensets and explicit intercept selection ladder must be removed; router must derive all policy sets from a single registry authority.
Every command route must carry exactly one registered runtime-used argparse factory and one generated help artifact, with both generators yielding byte-identical output on second render.
Whole-route and whole-parser shadow comparison must report no behavioral delta except approved help/overview normalization across identity, mount, init, argv, exit codes, and capability posture.
All execution and degradation contracts must pass through real subprocess and production-path tests after compatibility exports are removed and module size constraints are met.
Source modules must stay below 800 lines with no mechanically-split file under 100 lines; no persisted ticket/event/bridge/binding format or data changes.
